notes.title: S.P.A.T. 0.42.2 BugFix
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG


Fixed incorrect display in the scope of a sniper rifle and radio tag rifle (when players saw the image of the scope of other players).
The bot refills ammo from supply.

notes.title: BugFix S.P.A.T. 0.31.5
notes.notes:
CHANGELOG

GAMEPLAY


The light grenade no longer shines through walls and solid objects. Damage range 25 meters, every 0.8 sec, damage 20.
Added a sight for a rifle with a radio beacon.
Headshot marker.
The display on the decoy shows green if it can be used and red if not.
Grenade will not damage the one who threw it.
Removed the flashlight from the grenade launcher.
Switches to the pistol faster.
Light grenades and mines - 3  instead of 5.
Now you can pick up the mine (button E).
A grenade launcher projectile detonates on contact with a monster.
A radio beacon with a rifle marks the target for 4 minutes.


FIXED


M4A1 first appears on the client, then the selected weapon.
The grenade launcher replenishes ammo when switching weapons.
Supply is visible in the air before drop.
The Yeti does not update armor on the client.
On the client, after the revive, the weapon hangs in the air.
Decoy and pistol closer to the camera.
Fixed pistol reload animation.
You can switch guns after death and you can see them.
A rifle with a radio beacon has one round after being revived.
Added Airplane Sound at the grenade launcher drop in the Yeti quest.

notes.title: BugFix S.P.A.T. 0.25.1
notes.notes:
Thanks for your feedback, they help to fix critical gameplay bugs!


Fixed problem of Yeti getting stuck after quest in a cave.
Fixed shotgun animation. Also reduced the total number of rounds, to 56.
